metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: OpenCode, Pi, and DSH as second coding agents, and a TypeScript language server that runs on TypeScript 7.

plugins.name: opencode
plugins.description: Use OpenCode from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: pi
plugins.description: Use Pi (a local-model coding agent) from Claude Code to delegate investigation and implementation tasks.

plugins.name: dsh
plugins.description: Use DSH (DeepSeek Harness, via dst run) from Claude Code to delegate investigation and implementation tasks.

plugins.name: typescript7-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript language server for Claude Code that works with TypeScript 7 (tsc --lsp --stdio).
